caption:
Small Business Saturday checklist: 4 things Black-owned businesses should fix before November 28, when shoppers start asking friends where to buy.

American Express released its 2026 Shop Small Impact Study on November 12. 88% of US consumers said they're likely to shop at small businesses this holiday season, the highest level since 2012. Recommendations from friends and family are the top way they choose a small business (65%), followed by customer reviews (45%) and social media posts (39%).

So when someone hears about your shop, the next thing they do is look you up. Here's what they should find:
1. A logo that stays sharp on a phone screen and as your profile picture.
2. Recent photos of your products, your space and your team.
3. A website with your hours, location and a clear way to buy or book.
4. Fresh reviews you've actually replied to.

Small Business Saturday is November 28, 2026, so there's still time to get this right.
